augment_text_with_replacement: augment a list of text strings by replacing each with a specified replacement text
augment_single_text: augment a single text string by replacing it entirely with a specified replacement string
augment_with_dict_mapping: augment text using a dictionary mapping to replace specific strings with their mapped values
replace_text_directly: replace a single text string with a replacement string or dictionary lookup value
replace_with_fallback: replace text using a dictionary that returns the original text if no mapping exists
